name: OpenShift or Kubernetes API Bearer Token
description: A bearer token for one Kubernetes or OpenShift API server. On the native path it is the credential of the cluster whose api_server its host names, and of no other device; on the Ansible path it sets AWX's K8S_AUTH_* environment for kubernetes.core.

fields.label: OpenShift or Kubernetes API Endpoint
fields.help_text: The OpenShift or Kubernetes API Endpoint to authenticate with.

fields.label: Verify SSL
fields.help_text: On unless set to false. With no certificate authority below, the server is checked against the system's roots; false turns checking off on the Ansible path only, since the native path checks every cluster.
